description: Authoritative secret-rotation policy for the apikeys-vault field app. TWO distinct secret classes: (1) the APP's own auth secrets (the per-tenant bearer tokens), which are ENV-INJECTED only — server.mjs loadTenantTokens reads WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS; values never touch tracked source; and (2) the TENANT-ISSUED API keys this vault manages as its domain, whose lifecycle (issue -> rotate -> revoke) IS the product. This file declares NAMES, ownership, and rotation hygiene ONLY; it contains zero secret VALUES by construction. Issued tenant keys are stored as sha256 hashes (never raw) and are rotated via POST /keys/:id/rotate, which mints fresh material and changes the stored hash — proven by test/rotation.test.mjs.

secrets.name: WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS
secrets.description: Composite JSON env var consumed by server.mjs loadTenantTokens(): a {tenantId -> bearer-token} map authenticating the control plane. The single place app credentials enter the process. Absent/blank => deny-by-default (every request 401s). Injected by the deploy platform; never committed.

secrets.name: API_TOKEN_TENANT_A
secrets.description: Per-tenant control-plane bearer token for tenant A. Injected into the composite WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS map at deploy time; presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and compared in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual). Name only — value is never stored here or in any tracked file.

secrets.name: API_TOKEN_TENANT_B
secrets.description: Per-tenant control-plane bearer token for tenant B. Injected into the composite WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS map at deploy time; presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and compared in constant time. Name only — value is never stored here or in any tracked file.

issued_key_rotation_policy.description: The substantive rotation policy for the API KEYS this vault ISSUES to tenants (the domain). Each key is minted from crypto.randomBytes(32) at issue, stored as sha256(raw) only, and shown raw exactly once. Rotation re-mints material and replaces the stored hash, invalidating the prior credential.
issued_key_rotation_policy.raw_key_exposure: once-at-issue-or-rotate; never re-fetchable; redacted from all logs

rotation_proof.asserts: rotate changes the stored hash, mints a NEW raw key, invalidates the old credential, and writes a 'rotate' audit row

fleet_snapshot.note: fleet is freshly seeded this run; oldest issued key age is 0 days, well under the 90-day rotation_max_age_days. Enforcement is the operator's runbook duty; the vault provides the rotate/revoke primitives and the audit trail to evidence it.

static_secret_scan.scope: tracked source/config under WALTEUR_ROOT (.ts/.js/.mjs/.json/.env/.yml/... ), pruning node_modules/.git/walteur-kit
